\ubblockdescription{detection.pan_matrix_profile}{At which window lengths does anything repeat? The matrix profile, for a ladder of window lengths (30 s to 1 h by default): rows are lengths, longest at the top; time runs along the bottom; the pixel in column i is bright when the window starting at sample i (not centred on it) has a close look-alike of the same length elsewhere in the span (shape only --- each window is z-normalised, so loudness is ignored). Each length is compared with amplitude-adjusted copies of the span (the recording's own values reshuffled: the same colour of noise, no shapes). The answer is the band of lengths that repeat beyond those copies ('clears from A to B s; strongest gap at C s'), or 'no length stands out' --- nothing repeats more than this kind of noise at any tested length, not that nothing happens. The strongest-gap length (meta suggested\_window\_s) is the strongest of the band, NOT the event's length and not a window to hand another block: it leans long when an event dominates long windows and toward the edges on chains. Tune `max\_window\_s` first: a length is judged only if the span is 14 windows long --- 4 h judges up to 17 min, 8 h up to 34 min, so a drop chain's \textasciitilde{}30 min unit is out of reach on an 8 h span (expect 'no length' or the 30-72 s fall edge); judge chains on 24 h or more, or read the picture. Detrend first. Two occurrences must have the same length to match. A held value lasting `stall\_s` or longer (a stalled logger; found after the detrend too) is left out and counted. Followed by Wavelet summation, the summed band reads 'how strongly the windows starting here repeat across these lengths' (row\_from 0 = the longest); it is NaN over the last m \ensuremath{-} 1 samples of the band's longest row (an hour at the 3600 s default). Costs one full matrix profile per length plus null\_draws per judged length.}

  \ubparam{n\_\allowbreak{}lengths}{12}{whole number from 1 to 32}{How many lengths, spaced geometrically from shortest to longest}%

  \ubparam{null}{\texttt{aaft}}{one of \texttt{aaft}, \texttt{phase}}{The noise copies: 'aaft' keeps the recording's own values (use this); 'phase' makes them bell-shaped and is kept only for comparison}%
  \ubparam{seed}{0}{whole number, at least 0}{Seed of the null copies}%
  \ubparam{max\_\allowbreak{}fill\_\allowbreak{}s}{5.0}{number, at least 0}{NaN gaps up to this long are bridged by a straight line; longer gaps stay empty and every window touching one is left out (placeholder: dropouts of a few samples)}%
  \ubparam{stall\_\allowbreak{}s}{60.0}{number, at least 3}{A held value (a stalled logger, a clipped stretch) lasting this long or longer is left out and counted --- found by its second differences staying near zero, so a held value the detrend has bent into a near-straight line is caught too (placeholder: a quantised 1 Hz logger never holds still this long by chance)}%
